subject: derived_tests
summary: Derived Vitest for Reservation::lookup covers every live W1 success post at standard density: ResultIsHoldDetails (sku/quantity/expiresAt, plus holdId), AvailableStockUnchanged, and HoldsUnchanged, including a multi-hold/multi-SKU isolation case. Prior reserve/release/expire contract suites are retained. PrincipalAuthorized / HoldExists violation cases are deferred with ApplicationPlan and OCL W2 stubs (named failure posts still commented)—not a W1 checkability hole; suite is not empty or “does not throw” only. Red until implement is acceptable. solidsdd-lint pass (overlapping touches minor only).

findings.detail: lint: overlapping touches ['contracts/Reservation.ocl', 'src/reservation.ts']; solidsdd-run must serialize these items

Live OCL pre PrincipalAuthorized / HoldExists have no rejection cases yet. W1 ApplicationPlan and OCL defer named missing/not-visible and unauthorized failure posts to W2, so omitting those paths here does not lose W1 authorized-success checkability; elevate named-error + no-mutation tests in W2 alongside the live failure posts.

Tests assert result.holdId equals the looked-up id, which is stronger than OCL ResultIsHoldDetails (sku/quantity/expiresAt only) and aligns with OpenAPI LookupResponse. Fine as extra checkability; optional OCL holdId equality remains a polish item from dbc critique.
